about: Provenance recorded immediately after the foreground evaluation process completed successfully. This file is not harness output; it is kept separate from run_config.json so observed runtime configuration is not misrepresented as data written by the harness.
verdict_written_at_status: observed live, not recorded by the harness
verdict_written_at_source: results/eval-h1-l3x12-2026-07-31/h1_report.json was written during the foreground dcode_eval.run process on 2026-07-31, and that process then exited with status 0.

execution.aborted_first_attempt: An earlier attempt at this same command was stopped during B3 and its partial output was deleted, because Redis still held agent tool-result entries written about two hours earlier, before the current agent code existed. Those entries could have supplied graph results lacking the chunk_id the new scoring protocol reads. Redis was flushed (59 keys) and the whole suite was rerun from B1. The recorded run is the complete rerun; no partial output from the aborted attempt survives in this directory.
execution.embedding_healthcheck: healthy; a one-text request returned a 768-dimension vector
execution.reranker_healthcheck: healthy; a two-passage request returned two clearly separated scores (0.957 / 0.0000189)

scoring_protocol_note: run_config.json records scoring_protocol=final_verified_evidence_v1. Under it B2 and B3 are scored on their retrieved top-k while B4 is scored on its ordered verified final evidence. The two arms are therefore scored by different rules; see the limitations below and docs/en/Final_Report.md.
limitations: The verdict is protocol-sensitive at the margin it turns on. Official mixed scoring gives B4 vs B3 margins of +0.083 on L2 and +0.045 on L3, so L3 misses the 0.05 bar by 0.005 and the decision is unsupported. Scoring B3 on its own verified final evidence as well -- a rule the harness already computes but which was never pre-registered symmetrically -- gives +0.057 on L2 and +0.051 on L3, which would clear both. The pre-registered rule is the one reported. The alternative is recorded here so nobody has to rediscover that the answer depends on it.

The pre-registered justification for that asymmetry is falsified by this run. docs/en/Final_Report.md argued the rule handicaps B4 because its evidence set is smaller than five. B4's verified final evidence scored higher than its own candidate top-5 (recall 0.448 vs 0.401, MRR 0.763 vs 0.634), so the rule helped B4 rather than handicapping it.

The call graph's own contribution is small and now measured rather than inferred. Structural evidence that was not already in the hybrid top-k produced 4 new ground-truth hits across 3 of 33 questions. B4's margin over B3 therefore cannot be attributed to the call graph; separating graph gain from multi-step agent evidence selection needs the B3.5 ablation, which does not exist yet.

B1 and B2 answer from a template, so their groundedness of 1.000 is a constant rather than a measurement, and their final-evidence metrics are 0.0 because a template emits no citation events. Any B4-vs-B2 comparison is therefore between two different scoring rules.
The pairwise judge remains a stub, so pairwise_win_rate is unmeasured.
L3 has 12 questions, so one question moves the level composite by up to 0.083 -- larger than the 0.005 by which L3 missed the bar. q-033 alone scored -0.156 for B4 against B3.

17 of the 33 questions are labelled source=graph_reverse: they were reverse-constructed from the indexed call relationships and source of this corpus, so flows the graph cannot resolve are absent from them by construction, which favours B4.

Three pre-existing L2/L3 question pairs share ground truth at 1.00, 0.75 and 0.50 (q-006/q-014, q-009/q-016, q-010/q-015), so the L2 and L3 strata are not independent samples and the conjunction of the two level tests is weaker evidence than two independent tests.
The agent's max_steps is 8 and B4's expansion saturates it, so get_file_outline is rarely reached.
One repository and 33 questions. Nothing measured here generalises.
Service endpoints and secret values are intentionally not recorded.
